name: Laguna Phuket Marathon 2027

ai_summary: Laguna Phuket Marathon 2027 is a road running event in Ban Bang Thao, Phuket, Thailand, featuring Full Marathon (42.195KM), Half Marathon (21.0975KM), 10KM, 5KM, 2KM Junior. The race takes place on June 12, 2027, starting from Laguna Phuket, Ban Bang Thao. Registration is Priority registration open for 2026 finishers as of the last check.
